query:
SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(
                   c.id::text || ':' || c.version || ':' || a.blob_sha256 || ':'
                       || c.updated_at::text,
                   ',' ORDER BY c.id), '')) AS "digest!"
        FROM component c
        JOIN asset a ON a.component_id = c.id AND a.path = $2
        WHERE c.repository_id = $1 AND c.listed
